title: 109 Dandelion Drive Vacation Rental
meta_description: 109 Dandelion Drive is a 5.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Description Please Note: This home has recently undergone a full remodel with significant upgrades throughout. We are currently updating the listing to reflect these improvements. New photos and additional details will be available by mid-April 2026. Perfectly situated across from the WaterColor Tennis Center and just steps from Seaside, 109 Dandelion Drive offers a spacious and inviting retreat designed for families and groups. With 3,300 square feet of living space, this pet-friendly home comfortably accommodates up to 10 guests and includes a 6-passenger electric cart, six adult bikes, and Beach Club access for the ultimate 30A experience. Property Highlights Exclusive Access to the WaterColor Beach Club and Community Pools with Up to 10 Passes Included 6-Passenger Electric Cart Included in Rental 6 Adult Bikes Included in Rental Parking for 2 Vehicles Pet Friendly (Additional Fee Applies) Outdoor Dining in Screened Porch Third-Floor Watchtower Office Outdoor Grill Enclosed Outdoor Shower Directly Across From the WaterColor Tennis Center 2-Minute Bike Ride to Camp WaterColor 4-Minute Bike Ride to WaterColor Beach Club 1 Block From Seaside Path Experience the Home This home has recently undergone a full remodel with significant upgrades throughout. We are currently updating the listing to reflect these improvements. New photos and additional details will be available by mid-April 2026. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor: Guest Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Hall Bathroom with Walk-In Shower Kitchen, Living Room, Laundry Room Second Floor: Primary Bedroom: King Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Jetted Tub and Walk-In Shower Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Private Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed (Sleeps 2), Shared Bathroom with Tub/Shower Combination Third Floor: Home Office Life in WaterColor Centrally located in the Cottage District, 109 Dandelion Drive offers easy access to Camp WaterColor, the Beach Club, and Seaside. Enjoy tennis across the street, bike rides along 30A, or relaxing evenings on the screened porch. With its thoughtful layout, pet-friendly design, and luxury touches, this home delivers a quintessential WaterColor experience for the entire family.
